name: Two-Hand Finishing Drill Under the Rim
setup: Start a few steps out from the basket, ball in both hands.
cues: Alternate sides under the basket, a soft finish off the glass each time.
High knee up toward the target on the take-off.
Protect the ball with the off arm, the ball high and away.

faults.fault: Taking off too far under the basket
faults.fix: Leave the floor a step earlier so you rise up to the target.
Carry the ball high, chin to forehead, away from the reach.

name: Backboard Tip Drill
setup: Stand under the basket facing the backboard, ball in both hands.
cues: Tip the ball off the glass with one hand, again and again, without landing long.
Catch the ball high with both hands and keep it high.
Land quiet and balanced, ball tight under the chin.

faults.fault: Bringing the ball down low after the catch
faults.fix: Keep the ball high, chin to forehead, away from the reach.
Land on both feet at once, quiet, hips low.

name: Finger Roll Layup
setup: Start a few steps out on one side of the basket, ball in both hands.
cues: Roll the ball off the fingertips up toward the target, palm up.
Lift the ball high and soft toward the target on the glass.
Rise straight up off the floor, not into the basket support.

faults.fault: Throwing the ball hard at the glass
faults.fix: Lift the ball soft: let it kiss the glass and drop.
Take off a step earlier so you rise up to the target.
